title: Hypoxia- and Inflammation-Related Transcription Factor SP3 May Be Involved in Platelet Activation and Inflammation in Intracranial Hemorrhage.
authors: Wan, Ding; Feng, Jin; Wang, Peng; Yang, Zhenxing; Sun, Tao
one_liner_zh: 该研究基于转录组数据构建miRNA-TF-mRNA调控网络，识别SP3等转录因子与颅内出血炎症/缺氧的关联，但仅涉及TF的序列调控关系，无蛋白-DNA三维互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题核心方法脱节。
abstract: The purpose of this study was to identify the biomarkers implicated in the development of intracranial hemorrhage (ICH) and potential regulatory pathways. In the transcriptomic data for patients with ICH, we identified DEmiRNAs and DEmRNAs related to hypoxia, inflammation, and their transcription factors (TFs). An ICH-based miRNA-TF-mRNA regulatory network was thus constructed, and four biomarkers (TIMP1, PLAUR, DDIT3, and CD40) were screened for their association with inflammation or hypoxia by machine learning. Following this, SP3 was found to be a transcription factor involved in hypoxia and inflammation, which regulates TIMP1 and PLAUR. From the constructed miRNA-TF-mRNA regulatory network, we identified three axes, hsa-miR-940/RUNX1/TIMP1, hsa-miR-571/SP3/TIMP1, and hsa-miR-571/SP3/PLAUR, which may be involved in the development of ICH. Upregulated TIMP1 and PLAUR were validated in an independent clinical cohort 3 days after ICH onset. According to Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA), SP3 was discovered to be important in interleukin signaling and platelet activation for hemostasis. Transcription factor SP3 associated with hypoxia or inflammation plays an important role in development of ICH. This study provides potential targets for monitoring the severity of inflammation and hypoxia in patients with ICH.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在识别与颅内出血（ICH）发生相关的生物标志物及潜在调控通路。在ICH患者的转录组数据中，我们鉴定了与缺氧、炎症及其转录因子（TFs）相关的DEmiRNAs和DEmRNAs。由此构建了基于ICH的miRNA-TF-mRNA调控网络，并通过机器学习筛选出四种与炎症或缺氧相关的生物标志物（TIMP1、PLAUR、DDIT3和CD40）。随后，发现SP3是参与缺氧和炎症的转录因子，调控TIMP1和PLAUR。从构建的miRNA-TF-mRNA调控网络中，我们识别出三个轴：hsa-miR-940/RUNX1/TIMP1、hsa-miR-571/SP3/TIMP1和hsa-miR-571/SP3/PLAUR，这些可能参与ICH的发生。在独立的临床队列中，ICH发病后3天，TIMP1和PLAUR的上调得到了验证。根据基因集富集分析（GSEA），发现SP3在白细胞介素信号传导和血小板激活以促进止血中起重要作用。与缺氧或炎症相关的转录因子SP3在ICH的发生中扮演重要角色。本研究为监测ICH患者炎症和缺氧严重程度提供了潜在靶点。
